Theme - every snippet recolors via --accent:
Modules 8 + 18 - creative-html-css-js-techniques

48 live effects, one per tab

Every snippet is zero-dependency, scoped under an .fx-* wrapper, themeable via CSS custom properties, and carries prefers-reduced-motion handling. Wave 1 (S01-S24, sections A-E) lives in module-08; Wave 2 (S25-S48, sections F-K) in module-18 - report charts, scrollytelling, 3D, physics, controls, theming, and reactive pieces. Pick from the sidebar; theme swatches at the bottom of the menu recolor everything live.

DROP-IN

Pastes into an existing styled report without fighting the page - scoped styles, graceful degradation, no body-level takeover. 22 of 24 snippets.

SECTION-PIECE

Works in a real deliverable but needs its own dedicated container and sizing: S01 constellation and parallax divider.

Browser notes

S09 (anchor positioning), S10/S12 (scroll-driven), and S13 (view transitions) want a current Chrome/Edge - all degrade gracefully elsewhere.
